checks.requirement: C++23 asset preparation, application/test resource closure and Windows-only Dwrite linkage
checks.evidence: Root inherits required C++23 and latest-Kit selection. prepare-assets links public Gui and adds dwrite only under WIN32. Neither application nor AssetTest links Dwrite. Common qrc generator uses explicit manifest file list and root-relative BASE; moc/qml registration compiles AssetFonts into Yalahoo, while tests compile the same font initialization without a second module. No platform branch bypasses resources or tests. Windows Release proves shared target/resource closure.
checks.limitations: No actual macOS/Linux compile/link; later platform deployment remains R31/R32 scope.

checks.requirement: Portable SFNT, qrc aliases, Unicode/case/space paths and functional icon extraction

sources.symbol: Portable SFNT absent; prepare fonts once with Windows DirectWrite

checks.evidence: Original WOFF2 and portable OTF/CFF are embedded with case-exact manifest paths. Qt font registration reads only qrc and uses actual family/styleName for each CSS weight, preserving the original OS/2 values. Each selected face is verified against its embedded CFF/glyf table; when CoreText/Fontconfig expose different aliases, it enumerates only this registration's families/styles and selects the matching outline table. No match or malformed CSS mapping rolls back registrations and fails explicitly. It runs before engine.loadFromModule. Generated QML mesh URLs resolve relative to its qrc directory; all icons/audio/covers use /assets. Preparation-only QFile/QSaveFile paths derive from QDir repository argument. POSIX scripts quote repository and Kit paths, use platform library environment locally, and reuse SFNT only after input/output hash checks. Actual Windows Unicode/space cwd startup, font CFF comparisons and embedded-hash tests provide shared evidence.
checks.limitations: OS font backends still require user verification; source audit cannot prove Metal/FreeType glyph rendering.

checks.requirement: Preserve three imported meshes, coordinates/winding/normals/UV/paper separation and Qt backend portability
checks.evidence: The source GLB has identity nodes and three shell batches. Selected-Kit balsam disables LOD/scale/merge optimizations. Independent bounded inspectors match vertex attributes within 1e-6 and compare triangle multisets modulo cyclic start, retaining winding; all 1000 source triangles and batch bounds are preserved. V convention is explicitly inverted during comparison, no global axis flip is added. Source paper plane 0.027 remains between rearFront -0.032 and lidBack 0.052. Application probe scales uniformly, and loads three qrc mesh files through standard Model. No private renderer or backend-specific mesh path is added. Existing qsb pipeline still generates Qt backend variants, and shader-tools/actual Windows D3D11 model pixels pass.
checks.limitations: macOS Metal/Linux OpenGL mesh rendering is unexecuted. Probe materials are deliberately temporary; glass/lighting recreation is later-round scope. Mesh format revisions fail preparation explicitly and require inspector adaptation to the selected latest Kit.

checks.requirement: Resource media loading/lifecycle without synthesis, PCM conversion or unexpected playback
checks.evidence: Four complete bundled sources are copied byte-for-byte. Each test creates its own QMediaPlayer, opens qrc without QAudioOutput, waits for LoadedMedia/InvalidMedia with a timeout, checks public error/duration/stopped state and zero playing events, then destroys the object and connections. Product startup continues to use source-free public media objects. All 17 original Sound events exist but have null source/disabled status because originals rely on synthesis/embedded PCM, not independent short files. No typing-preview, decoder/sink, custom PCM or external FFmpeg command is introduced. QProcess only launches Kit tools in asset preparation, never application startup.
checks.limitations: This is resource-loading verification, not playback/output-device behavior; actual player implementation belongs to R24/R25. macOS/Linux backend decoding is user verification.

静态审计通过，实机待用户验证

checks.evidence: Asset preparation records source/input/output hashes and verifies all 24 different inputs against frozen Git blobs, including icon/font CSS. The verification script requires repeat generation to retain the manifest SHA-256, runs all registered Windows CTest suites plus qmllint in Release, copies sanitized reports and actual screenshots, and launches Release from a Unicode/space cwd. Audit checks every resource file and manifest list against hashes before concluding; source paths/symbols/hashes and explicit branch traces accompany every check. License, authorship and font notices remain. Existing R02 matrices are preserved separately.
checks.limitations: Static evidence does not claim macOS/Linux execution, full GUI recreation, audio playback or deployment acceptance.
